originalityClaim: The creator attributes the conception and design of this distinctive integrated notebook architecture to Anouar Oumlili. This records the creator's claim and project provenance; it is not an independent worldwide novelty determination.
inventionDescription: Unlike a conventional notes-only notebook, the documented concept brings five connected spaces into one notebook wall: writing for poems, texts and ideas; an in-app reading library; Quran radio; a tasbeeh and remembrance counter; and book creation from the user's writing with import and export. A separate tool strip includes archive, radio access, day/night appearance, colors and backup. The concept also includes background audio playback and one-tap QR creation for pages, websites and poems.
designDistinction: The claimed innovation is the integrated structure and workflow of these literary, reading, audio, devotional and publishing spaces in one notebook experience, not the generic idea of a digital notebook.
